`solve_model` still obtains callback snapshots from `n.snapshots`, not the model’s stored snapshots. If a model is built with MultiIndex snapshots and the network’s snapshots are subsequently changed to a single-level index, `_model_snapshot_context` selects non-flat mode and `_to_model` returns that single-level index unchanged. Thus the callback can receive a representation different from the model’s.
